<b>Pond Skippers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are dark-bodied bugs that skim across the surface of the water on all fours.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
The Pond Skipper does not attack directly, only dealing contact damage. It glides left and right across the water randomly. If Hornet gets too close, they may let out a small growl before moving again, sometimes diving under the water to reappear later. 

Pond Skippers can sometimes be encountered being hunted by [[Pondcatcher]]s. The Pondcatchers defeat these enemies on their own unless they spot Hornet.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Pond Skippers have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* Shifting root... grasping branch...
* Creeping, creeping...
* High and low, all around...
* Climbing, climbing...
}}

== Location ==
Pond Skippers can be found primarily in [[Shellwood]], where they randomly appear on any body of water. They can also be found in a section of the [[Memorium]], where they do the same.
